recipes.name: Segmented control
recipes.notes: There is no .active class — the selected segment is the one carrying data-variant="primary" while its siblings stay ghost. Drive selection with aria-pressed and swap the variant when it changes. The variant axis is class-qualified: every segment carries .el-variants, because that class is what answers data-variant.

recipes.name: Search input bar
recipes.markup: ⌘K
recipes.notes: Provide an accessible label when no visible label is present. There is no .kbd class — a bare span carries the shortcut hint. Icons come from the fractalicons package, never inline SVG or unicode glyphs.

recipes.name: Responsive metrics grid
recipes.markup: 99.98% Availability
recipes.notes: Repeat the card child for each metric; grid-4 owns responsive column stepping. Card padding rides data-pad, and the card's surface rides data-variant — both need their class: .el-pad and .el-variants. A card carries no data-size; it sizes through .el-pad and the layout classes.

recipes.name: Profile action row
recipes.markup:
AV
Alex Vancealex@example.com
recipes.notes: There is no .avatar class — .chip carries the initials. Give the image meaningful alt text when it conveys information not already present in adjacent text. There is no .icon class either: an icon-only button is a .button carrying .el-variants with data-variant="icon".

recipes.name: Settings switch row
recipes.markup: Enable telemetryCollect anonymized traces.
recipes.notes: There is no switch-track / switch-thumb / .checked class — the system ships no switch component, so use a native checkbox inside .checkbox-wrapper. Partition borders are .bb and .bt, not .border-bottom.

recipes.name: Action dialog
recipes.markup:
Confirm action

Review this action before continuing.
recipes.notes: Use the native dialog API and return focus to the invoking control. There is no .dialog class and no .pad-0 (the ladder starts at .pad-xs) — put the padding on the inner regions instead.

recipes.name: Dropdown action menu
recipes.notes: There is no .popover or .open class — show and hide the panel with the native hidden attribute or a framework conditional. .xleft is a container modifier and does not apply to buttons; use .ta-l to align menu item text.

recipes.name: Application status bar
recipes.markup:

recipes.notes: Do not rely on color alone for connection state. There is no .square-6 class — .chip carries the state label.
